title: Compare CATPart folders
description: Filenames are not used for matching. Geometry results are suggestions that require review.
runPrompt: Select both CATPart folders, then start the analysis.
noCatparts: No CATPart files were found in at least one folder.
readerAvailable: CADMPEG produced partial geometry signatures; candidates are not certain matches.
readerMissing: CADMPEG is not installed or configured. Identical copies are hidden; remaining files have no byte-identical counterpart in the other folder. They may be modified, added, or removed.
readerNotRequired: Identical files were compared; no geometry analysis was needed.
exactSkipped: Identical copies hidden: {{oldCount}} older and {{newCount}} newer.
candidateDescription: The score compares partial geometry primitives. It does not prove the files are the same part.
pairConflict: This file is already assigned to another confirmed pair.
noCandidates: No candidate pair reached the heuristic threshold.
unmatchedTitle: Remaining files without an identical counterpart
noneUnmatched: No remaining files without an identical counterpart.
unmatchedDescription: A remaining file may be modified, added, or removed; the absence of an identical hash does not distinguish these cases.
limit: The prototype accepts at most 100 CATPart files per folder.
